title: Letter to Kagha

sources.title: Investigate Kagha
markers: The quest then begins and the party can confront Kagha

summary: Read the letter to expose the Shadow Druids and unlock the confrontation with Kagha.

fields.Read: Advances Investigate Kagha and unlocks dialogue confronting Kagha. Finding and reading it before picking up the grove clue can start the quest.
fields.Acquisition: A DC 5 Perception check reveals the wooden crevice in the large tree on the island in the Putrid Bog, part of the Sunlit Wetlands. The quest pin places the tree around X 86, Y 220.

changes: Added native BG3 quest and Inspiration uses verified against pinned item and quest revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
